findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "scan_ai_visibility" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Start a free AI-visibility scan for a B2B company's website. Checks how often AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Copilot…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_ai_visibility · Public sink: scan_ai_visibility, get_visibility_report · Destructive: scan_ai_visibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_ai_visibility · Public sink: scan_ai_visibility, get_visibility_report · Destructive: scan_ai_visibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
